2. The present criminal writ petition has been filed on 08.08.2023 but still it is under Office defects.

3. This criminal writ petition has been filed for the following reliefs:
"(a) for issuance of issuance of an appropriate writ/writs, order/orders or direction/directions, including a writ in the nature of mandamus, commanding upon the respondents as to why no steps have been taken till date to arrest the accused (Opposite Party No.5) in Ramgarh PS Case No. 73/2021 for the offences u/s 406, 420 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, currently pending adjudication before the Learned CJM, Rangarh despite their being a clear direction of the Court of Sessions Judge, Ramgarh vide its order dated 22.06.2022 passed in B.P No.265/2022 to arrest the Opposite Party No.5 and the subsequent issuance of Non bailable warrant of arrest by the Learned Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ramgarh vide its order dated 23.06.2022; and (b) For any other relief or reliefs for which the petitioners are legally entitled in the M/S Manya Traders Through Its ... vs The State Of Jharkhand Through The ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116774850/
1 facts and circumstances of the case."
4.

entities.text: M/S Manya Traders Through Its ... vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been submitted that the Company has been cheated by respondent no.5 and he has been granted provisional bail subjected to certain conditions but, the conditions have not fulfilled.

5. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that the investigation is complete and against the four co-accused, the final form has been submitted and respondent no.5 has already been charge-sheeted.
6. Considering the fact that the investigation is complete and the matter is pending for trial before the competent court, I find no reason to entertain this criminal writ petition.
7. Accordingly, this criminal writ petition stands dismissed.
